rules.tool_inclusion: Monthly service fees include standard software and infrastructure within the listed service limits. No separate standard tool fee.
rules.scope_limit: Before exceeding limits, agree a new bundled tier. Never invent overage rates or silently add charges. Where a hard cap is possible, stop at the cap; monitoring and client communication are still required.
exceptions: Premium or high-renewal domains outside the standard allowance
rules.estimate: Informational estimate, valid 30 days, subject to requirements, availability and owner confirmation. From items produce a starting estimate, never a fixed total.
rules.discounts: Only owner-approved discounts with explicit SKU, amount and duration. Jasper cannot independently waive setup or change monthly prices.
rules.setup: All installations have setup fees. Ongoing-only services require their listed onboarding or a verified existing installation. Do not add fictitious setup to one-time advisory sessions.
rules.cancellation: Proposed add-ons are month-to-month, with cancellation before next renewal. Annual third-party commitments are internal costs unless explicitly agreed otherwise. Do not change an existing customer agreement.
rules.billing: Add-on recurring charges begin when the service is activated. Website development uses existing 50/50 terms. Hardware/software procurement, annual registrations and waived setup must be accounted for internally.
rules.included_support: Support allowances are per calendar month, do not roll over, and cover the installed configuration. New features, content creation and major revisions excluded; approved extra work is $75/hour, $37.50 minimum.
rules.hosting: Feature add-ons do not include the base website hosting unless expressly stated. Determine whether the customer already has suitable hosting. Do not force a new website purchase for standalone email, scheduling or domains.
rules.exclusions: No general copywriting, photography/video production, social content creation or review responses. Campaign ad text is included only in PPC.
rules.custom_work: Custom project prices are starting estimates until requirements and delivery are confirmed.
